name: Block Gallery to Carousel Lightbox
author: Atakan Au

sections.description: Block Gallery to Carousel Lightbox is a user-friendly plugin for the WordPress Block Editor that seamlessly converts your default Block Gallery into a beautiful Carousel Lightbox featuring attractive thumbnail displays. Perfect for beginners, this plugin requires no coding skills and easily integrates with your existing WordPress setup. For more information, visit blog page!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the block-gallery-to-carousel-lightbox folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
How to Configure Block Gallery for Carousel Lightbox?

  1. Add a Gallery block to your post or page.
  2. Set Gallery images to Thumbnail resolution.
  3. Add CSS class “atakanau_bgtcl_auto_container” in the Advanced section.
  4. Link images to Media File.
